hero.subtitle: Clubs, bars, fraternities and private events across the Southeast — and wherever the booking takes him.

about.heading: Reads the room. Runs the night.
about.bio1: DJ Reese is a rising open-format DJ based in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, known for his ability to read any crowd and seamlessly switch between genres to keep the energy high all night. With a deep passion for music, Reese began DJing out of pure love for sound and quickly turned that passion into a fast-growing career.
about.bio2: What sets DJ Reese apart is his versatility and creativity. From hip-hop to house and everything in between, he blends styles effortlessly while incorporating his own unique mixes and edits of popular tracks. His ability to adapt to an audience has made him one of the most in-demand DJs in the region.
